reader_summary.overview: Acquired kicks off our China tech mini-series by teaming up with the best in the business: Hans and Zara from GGV’s 996 Podcast ! Together we cover the largest technology IPO in the world since fellow China tech giant Alibaba in 2014: Xiaomi. This episode is chock full of history and insight on both Xiaomi and what’s happening in China tech more broadly.
